clue.text: Hanger-on in airborne soldiers' base?

parts.note: a para is a paratrooper, a soldier dropped by parachute
a site is the base or location of something

explanation.surface: Someone clinging on at a paratroop barracks.
explanation.definitionFit: A parasite is a sponger who lives off others, which is what a hanger-on does.

clue.text: Audibly changed direction in diplomatic understanding

clue.text: Genius that is returning playing tennis

explanation.surface: A tennis prodigy is coming back to play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns IE into EI; 'playing' rearranges TENNIS into NSTEIN.

clue.text: Object sailor has to receive

explanation.definitionFit: A sack is a large bag of coarse cloth or paper for carrying goods.

clue.text: Approached artist for something to make a picture with

definitions.text: something to make a picture with

parts.note: came means approached, drew near

explanation.definitionFit: A camera is a device for taking photographs, so it makes pictures.

clue.text: Show daughter is nearby

clue.text: Milk pudding son wants earlier

clue.text: Further a London orchestra
